summary.text: Blood sickle grass is a Gu refinement grass whose mature stalks bend like sickles with knife-sharp edges.

claims.text: After the blood poison kerria earthly calamity, blood path dao marks remodel Hu Immortal blessed land. Newly exposed soil grows tender grass that matures into blood sickle grass, with stalks bent like sickles, broad and edged as sharp as a knife. Together with red axe flowers, it is an excellent Gu refinement material. It is not an immortal material, but it can be used to refine rank three mortal Gu. Mature fields across the blessed land can become a large source of wealth.

Poisonous blood seeping into the soil changes part of the older flowers’ and grasses’ roots and seeds into seeds of blood sickle grass and red axe flowers. Blood path dao marks create the living environment those plants need. Fang Yuan digs many poisonous blood lakes under Gu formation control so the blood seeps into the soil and nourishes their growth. Blood stripe rabbits eat blood sickle grass, which supports a planned chain of blood stripe rabbits, blood stripe foxes, and poison beard wolves in the western part of the land.
A sparse grassland of wildflowers and grass is mainly blood sickle grass and red axe flowers.
In Mini Northern Plains, Fang Yuan works to create a blood red grassland with blood sickle grass and red axe flowers as the foundation, so pink flower rabbits, wolves, and foxes can live there.
